Vendored component: blivedm 1.1.7
Upstream: https://github.com/xfgryujk/blivedm
Commit: 3bf17fe862b8c2fc6bc04c81c3f0c5db95de93d6
License: MIT (full text in BLIVEDM-LICENSE)
Retrieved and checked: 2026-10-25
Files: blivedm/ (upstream unchanged)

Protocol adaptation reference: https://github.com/Olmvormvhh/blivedm-260909
At inspection, both upstream master/dev and fork dev pointed to the same commit above.
The upstream implementation includes base64 + protobuf INTERACT_WORD_V2 and SEND_GIFT_V2;
DANMU_MSG remains the info-array format. Synthetic protobuf parsing tests cover both V2 commands.
Live authenticated room reception remains unverified until the user completes QR login.

Do NOT install the PyPI package named blivedm: upstream explicitly warns it is unrelated.
The host imports this local vendor copy. No upstream installation/build script is executed.
Upstream declares aiohttp~=3.9 and yarl~=1.9; this host intentionally uses maintained current
3.x/1.x versions and separately tests constructor, protobuf parsing, local HTTP and WebSocket
behavior. Authenticated Bilibili integration still requires a real-room test.
Open-live code is retained as upstream source but never instantiated by the host;
only BLiveClient (cookie-based receive-only web protocol) is used.
